status: source-only preparation; execution held until the full Supra fixed final comparison is independently qualified
question: Does PR227 neutral-H/b convergence survive when both generators must learn a new input basis instead of starting in the exact teacher span?
changed_factors: Teacher down row space only. Teacher outputs and frozen per-coordinate fit residual scales follow the changed target.

teacher_geometry.rho_source: mean historical ordinary linear-delta energy within fresh sampled Supra down span, across 71 fixed sites
teacher_geometry.complement: lexicographic canonical axes, projected against Q and previously accepted columns, with two reorthogonalization passes; no new random draws
invariants: Teacher down within-rank Gram and row norms
Teacher up values and fixed row norm0.5
teacher_geometry.software_expected: Squared principal cosines equal rho within rtol1e-6/atol1e-8; Gram max absolute error<=1e-7; rho1 exactly reproduces parent target panels; both families have bitwise exact teacher reachability.

host.routing: sequential sites, shared bank/controller, second site recomputed from first-site output
host.critic: 16->48->16 tanh features; pooled context score; explicit 769-dimensional source/time condition

prior.exception_reason: The subject is the shared routed ParticleGAN bank used by Supra, not a learned-MoG host.

initialization.networks: public particlegan.init.initialize_, sample_distributions_v1, distinct CPU generators bound to semantic parameter names
initialization.shared: bitwise identical ordinary/particle down/up and critic initial tensors; up factors zeroed after API initialization
initialization.teacher: Teacher initialized with the same public sampled API, then only its down span deterministically rotated; teacher up stays exactly fixed. The teacher is reachable by learning down/up in both families.
initialization.reachability_gate: Install teacher down/up into both families and zero particle H/C/b; require identical complete outputs on fit, guard and test panels before training.
initialization.supra_difference: This named sampled network initialization is explicit and differs from the earlier Supra deterministic-orthogonal network cohort.

data.latent_geometry: first 2 of 16 token activations weighted sqrt(7), remaining 14 weighted 1, then normalized to overall RMS 0.77; fixed input heterogeneity, never an error-selected training weight
data.condition: fixed 768-dimensional source embeddings with RMS approximately 0.052, plus time; frozen projection into host activations
data.schedule: editing only; same fixed context order across arms
data.critic_coordinate_scale: fit teacher-minus-base standard deviation per coordinate, clamped at 0.04 and fixed thereafter
data.rng: isolated named initialization, fit-index, paired-base, DV12, birth/death and private evaluation streams; no seed scan

arms.optimizer: native generator AMSGrad beta=(0,0.999), paired RpGAN and KA2 critic, native stationarity/noise policy
arms.scaffold: public UpdatePolicy with frozen unoptimized R2 table; no router/table optimizer groups; both row controls disabled
arms.comparison_limit: Native owner-dependent support-floor and noise eligibility can differ from the full particle arm. This is a configuration comparison, not a pure architecture ablation.

arms.optimizer: full public e22_routed, AMSGrad beta=(0,0.999), paired RpGAN and KA2 critic
arms.row_controls: enabled; full-model candidate reruns; per-site DV12 and usage attribution
arms.guard: zero per-context learned-critic-feature harm on FAST and EMA; output guards disabled

arms.sole_change: Zero fresh H/b after identical sampled initialization and before policy/EMA construction; C remains bit-exact and trainable.
arms.optimizer: Same full native e22_routed game, controls, rates, guard and named streams as particle_native_game.

execution.budget_includes: all three quality arms, fixed-panel evaluation, six replay software updates, and independent qualification; preparation software is reported separately; wall timeout or missing review is incomplete qualification
execution.artifact_archive: Exact held source/card/native Python bytes under source/, plus frozen data.pt and full-file SHA; checkpoint and raw-score manifests preserve all declared states.

evaluation.judges: All four actual newly trained baseline weights mandatory; no neutral or metric-selected critic replaces them.
evaluation.score: Native paired generator game on clean FAST outputs under fixed private Gaussian critic-input panels; all fit/guard/test pools. Exact same panel law, seeds and sigma as parent.
evaluation.all_saved_curves: All fixed 200-update checkpoints, including zero; no best-checkpoint or head selection.
evaluation.anchor: Zero teacher residual log2 under the original fixed common judges.
evaluation.output_metrics: Offline diagnostic only; prohibited in optimizer, structural decisions/guards, stopping and checkpoint/horizon/head selection.
evaluation.neutral_support_gate: At6400 improve original particles >1e-4 under all four judges, and reduce the original particle-versus-ordinary gap at least50% under both endpoint judges, with live retained particles.
evaluation.beat_ordinary_gate: At6400 neutral particles score lower than ordinary native game by >1e-4 under all four common judges.
evaluation.remaining_gap_witness: At6400 original particles are worse than ordinary by>1e-4 under BOTH fixed endpoint judges AND neutral particles remain worse by>1e-4 under BOTH, with live retained particles. Otherwise report no remaining original-gap witness, while retaining every signed score.
evaluation.particle_gate: Final H/b/C, bank and router remain trainable; C norms are nonzero at both sites; bank/router acquired live gradients; final zero-code game differs from live game>1e-6 under exactly all four mandatory critics. Report final gradients and every signed code gain.
evaluation.denominator_policy: If either original particle-minus-ordinary endpoint gap<=1e-4, the50% gap-reduction support test is inapplicable; report null reductions rather than negative or infinite fractions. H/b improvements and ordinary wins remain separate.
evaluation.reference_path: All four newly trained judges, all pools, all fixed residual fractions[0,.25,.5,1], log2 zero-residual anchor. Report weak or reversed judge directions without substituting heads; learned-game gains alone do not establish output accuracy.
evaluation.historical_mse_reference: No new MSE-trained arm. PR227 historical MSE metrics have a different teacher/scale/judges and cannot serve as a matched rotated-target baseline.

limits: The measured Supra historical down span is not its exact frozen-caption target span.
Weight-space angles omit activation covariance and coupled full-model routing.
The rotated teacher remains ordinary-LoRA generated and exactly reachable; this tests span acquisition, not all Supra complexities.
Teacher target and its fit whitening scale change together; this is not proof that span misalignment uniquely mediates full-Supra behavior.
One fixed task/stream; no seed scan, robust default promotion, or continuation.

Actual Supra overlap rho is near chance16/576; fixedrank2/width16 chance overlap is2/16=.125, so transplanting absolute rho tests a more severe toy acquisition regime, not a dimension-normalized replication.
The canonical complement changes activation covariance difficulty even though weight row Gram is preserved.
This task derives a new coordinate scale and trains new common critics. Absolute scores and gap percentages cannot be subtracted from PR227 as a causal effect size.
Native G/router/table LR releases, noise eligibility, surprise or structural responses can differ by configuration; a remaining task gap does not uniquely identify basis-angle mediation.

The audited71 Supra sites are70 rank16/inputwidth576 projections and one rank16/inputwidth768 projection. Their equal-site isotropic chance overlap is0.02767996870109542; measured mean squared cosine is0.027652886220233087 and measured linear-delta energy capture is0.027625366713810866.
